🔥 aqueli | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a comprehensive, private, and secure personal organization tool for Windows users, consolidating daily life management into a single, offline desktop application.
✨ Key Features: • All-in-one organizer (tasks, calendar, notes, habits, budget) • Private and entirely offline • Encrypted database • No account creation, cloud, or subscription
📖 Summary: Aqueli is a private, all-in-one personal organizer for Windows that consolidates tasks, calendar events, notes, habit tracking, and budgeting into a single, offline application. It emphasizes user privacy with local-first storage and end-to-end encryption, offering a customizable interface with a retro-inspired aesthetic.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 cloofy | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide a fully functional Spotify music player experience within a terminal environment, offering features comparable to the official desktop client.
✨ Key Features: • Terminal-based Spotify client • Plays music directly via librespot • Acts as a Spotify Connect device • Displays synced lyrics and cover art • Supports mouse and keyboard interactions
📖 Summary: cloofy is a Rust-based Spotify client that runs entirely within the terminal. It offers a full-featured music playback experience, including synced lyrics, cover art, and integration with Spotify Connect, all without requiring an official Spotify app or daemon.
🔗 Links: • View Project ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 survival-llm | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with an offline, private AI assistant for accessing survival, medical, and how-to information without requiring an internet connection.
✨ Key Features: • Offline and private operation • Source citation for every answer • Step-by-step reasoning display • Adjustable instructions and answer length • Ability to add and search personal files (PDF, DOC, EPUB, HTML, TXT)
📖 Summary: Survival LLM is a free, offline AI assistant and survival library that runs locally on your computer. It answers questions by searching an extensive offline library of medical, emergency, and how-to articles, providing cited sources and detailed reasoning for its responses.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🔥 vibra-code | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Building mobile applications using natural language descriptions powered by AI, with the ability to self-host and customize the development process.
✨ Key Features: • Open-source AI app builder • Describe what you want, AI builds it • Native preview on phone • Self-hostable • Customizable AI prompts
📖 Summary: Vibra Code is an open-source AI app builder that allows users to describe mobile applications in plain English, which are then generated by AI and previewed on a phone. It offers a self-hostable alternative to closed-source platforms, enabling customization of AI prompts and providers.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

🌟 pocketpaw | Python
🎯 Primary Use Case: To provide users with a private, self-hosted personal AI assistant that can be easily installed and integrated into their daily communication workflows.
✨ Key Features: • Self-hosted AI agent • Desktop installer and native app • Web dashboard • Integration with Discord, Slack, WhatsApp, Telegram, and browser • Support for Anthropic, OpenAI, or Ollama models
📖 Summary: PocketPaw is a self-hosted, open-source personal AI agent designed for quick deployment. It offers a desktop installer and a web dashboard, integrating with various communication platforms and AI models like OpenAI, Anthropic, or Ollama, while prioritizing user data privacy.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
